R API wrapper to the St. Louis Fed's FRED and ALFRED economic-data API
supporting both synchronous and asynchronous (promise based) operations.
Provides an R6 client for series observations, as-known-then ALFRED
vintages (paged for large matrices), series metadata, search, and
releases, built on the shared connectcore transport base with a
vintage-first, point-in-time-honest discipline.

# Package index

## R Functions

Pure R functions

- [`add()`](https://dereckscompany.github.io/fred/reference/add.md) :
  Add two numbers
